description: Attribute values that JavaScript and Rust print differently (1e21, 1e-7, 0.000001, -0, 1.0, 2^53 + 1, the shortest round-trip digits), values beyond the double range (1e400, kept as "Infinity" / "-Infinity" with a json-non-finite warning, in attributes, arrays and `meta`), integer-like object keys that JavaScript lists first, duplicate keys, `__proto__`, nested objects and arrays, numbers and integer-like keys in `meta`.
